rules.name: Delivery Proof Mandatory for Settlement
rules.statement: Financial settlement for an Order Request must only occur after a valid Delivery Proof is recorded and verified as successful.
rules.condition: When an Order Request reaches the Financial Settlement Handover confirmation stage
exceptions: Force majeure events declared by regulatory bodies preventing physical handover
rules.if_violated: The settlement batch is rejected and funds are held in escrow until proof is provided
rules.rationale: Prevents revenue leakage and ensures goods are actually delivered before payment is released

rules.name: Dispute Ticket Auto-Generation on Missing Proof
rules.statement: A Dispute Ticket must be created immediately upon receipt of a Delivery Proof indicating a missing item, damaged goods, or lack of valid timestamp/signature.
rules.condition: When a Delivery Proof is submitted with indicators of delivery failure or discrepancy
rules.if_violated: The Order Request remains in a pending state, blocking closure and potentially causing customer dissatisfaction
rules.rationale: Ensures rapid response to delivery failures and initiates the resolution workflow

parameters.name: dispute_trigger_threshold
parameters.description: Criteria defining what constitutes a delivery exception

rules.name: Delivery Proof Rejection for Cancelled Assignments
rules.statement: A Delivery Proof must not be accepted or processed if the associated Delivery Assignment is marked as cancelled.
rules.condition: When a Delivery Partner attempts to submit a Delivery Proof for an Order Request
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the submission and logs an error, preventing false settlement triggers
rules.rationale: Prevents fraudulent claims or errors where goods were never assigned for delivery

parameters.name: assignment_status
parameters.description: Current status of the Delivery Assignment (e.g., cancelled, active)

rules.name: Delivery Partner Score Update on Proof Submission
rules.statement: A Delivery Partner's performance score must be updated immediately upon the submission of a Delivery Proof record.
rules.condition: When a Delivery Proof is successfully submitted and validated
rules.if_violated: The partner's performance metrics remain stale, affecting future order allocation and compensation
rules.rationale: Ensures real-time accuracy of partner performance metrics for routing and incentive calculations

parameters.name: score_update_latency
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed between proof submission and score recalculation
